description: A learner has been promoted to a new stage, per SPEC's private stage-computation model. This is a lightweight notification event for downstream consumers (badges, leaderboard, push notifications). The authoritative stage-state record lives in SPEC's private backend, not on the public firehose.

learnerDid.description: The learner who was promoted. did:plc:... format.

fromStage.description: Stage before promotion. 0 = pre-stage-1 (never reached any stage). Used to compute total stage promotions in lifetime.

toStage.description: Stage after promotion. Must be fromStage + 1.

vAtPromotion.description: V_S (known lemmas) at time of promotion. Used to verify promotion validity and for analytics.

mAtPromotion.description: M_S (known patterns) at time of promotion. Used to verify promotion validity and for analytics.

promotedAt.description: UTC timestamp when promotion was computed.

sessionId.description: The fitting session that produced this promotion, per SPEC's private session bookkeeping.

sourceEventRef.description: Opaque reference to the private state record that triggered this event. Resolved internally by SPEC's backend; not a public AT-URI collection.

abilityBand.description: Ability band at time of promotion, from SPEC's private ability-estimation model, if available. Enables downstream enrichment: "S5 learner at advanced ability".

register.description: Register of the content active during this session.

milestoneType.description: Milestone label for badge assignment. beginner_promotion: any first promotion (fromStage=0) stage_5: reached S5 stage_10: reached S10 advanced: reached S7+ superior: reached S10
